evidenceMap.studyOrModelContext: Phase 3 partner-scoped depth. PMID 16508927 verified via PubMed/E-utilities. Competing explanation vs cytokine-axis-only narratives — ADA/immunogenicity as a response-heterogeneity mechanism. Infliximab-specific cohort; do not over-generalise to all anti-TNF agents at Gate C. Not CDS; partnerSigned=false.

evidenceMap.studyOrModelContext: Phase 3 partner-scoped depth. PMID 18375541 verified via PubMed/E-utilities. Seropositive patients showed smaller mean DAS28 improvement in this cohort — do not invent predictive CDS rules. Competes with RA-010 meta-analysis finding no association. Gate C = human Neon approve only.

evidenceMap.studyOrModelContext: Phase 3 partner-scoped depth. PMID 24586782 verified via PubMed/E-utilities. Explicit competing frame vs RA-009 — keep both visible; do not collapse serology into a confident response predictor. Meta-analysis heterogeneity noted in paper. Gate C = human Neon approve only. Not CDS.
